source: Genuine reference parameter readback (fresh instance: 'NS1' 0..100 % step 0.1 default 0.0; 'Bypass' boolean default Off) cross-checked against the shipped NS1.bundle ParamXML (PARAM_WET_DRY_CNTRL, Label 1Knob: 0..100 %, Resolution 0.1, linear, initial 0.0, DisplayFloat1) and the manual ch.3 (single FADER, ATTENUATION METER). Physical values are passed to Processor::setParameter.

parameters.name: NS1
parameters.note: Every value runs the continuous control law; calibrated captures cover 0/50/100 %, and the 25/75 % gate passed (docs/evidence/ns1).
